name: Renner YL-M648/-C02 Primer
use_cases: New Kitchens, MDF, New Wood, Cabinetry
application_method: Spray (conventional, airless, airmix, or electrostatic gun)
thinner_cleanup: Water; cross-linked with hardener YC M406 at 2-4% for 2K use
surface_prep: Sand or brush surface with 220-240 grit paper to minimize fiber swelling of MDF; clean thoroughly before application
description: A water-based 1K/2K urethane primer engineered to fill grain, build film thickness, and reduce fiber swelling on MDF and new wood, creating a smooth base before topcoating.

name: Renner Super Hang 1K/2K Topcoat T765
use_cases: Furniture, Onsite Cabinets, Doors, Trim
application_method: Spray, formulated for vertical application; self-sealing 1K or 2K use
thinner_cleanup: Water; catalyzed with Renner Topcoat Catalyst YC.M404 at 5% (one quart treats approximately 15 gallons of product)
description: A water-based 1K/2K acrylic urethane self-sealing topcoat built for vertical spray application with high build and sag resistance, used on furniture, cabinets, doors, and trim.

name: Renner Spray/Wipe Intermix Waterborne Stain System
use_cases: Interior Wood Surfaces, Furniture, Cabinetry
application_method: Brush, roller, pad, or spray; excess wiped off for desired effect
coverage: Up to 650 sq ft per gallon
thinner_cleanup: Water
surface_prep: Optimal application at 65-75°F with 40-60% relative humidity; used with Primer YL-M643/C02
description: A waterborne interior wood stain system built from 12 intermixable base stains that can be combined into 127 hues, applied by brush, roller, pad, or spray and wiped for the desired effect.

name: SuperDeck Exterior Oil-Based Semi-Transparent Stain
use_cases: Exterior Decking, Siding, Fencing, Doors, Shutters, Outdoor Furniture
application_method: Brush, Roller, Pad, Sprayer
coats_recommended: 1 coat (do not apply more than one coat)
coverage: 150-400 sq. ft. per gallon, depending on porosity and texture
dry_time_cure: 24-48 hours before use (drying/recoat times are temperature, humidity, and film-thickness dependent)
thinner_cleanup: Mineral spirits
surface_prep: Surface must be clean, dry, and free of dirt, mildew stains, dust, and other foreign matter; self-priming on clean bare wood
description: A penetrating oil-based, semi-transparent exterior wood stain that lets wood grain show through while repelling water and resisting UV fading, intended for exterior wood surfaces such as decks, siding, fences, and outdoor furniture.

name: WoodScapes Exterior Polyurethane Semi-Transparent House Stain
use_cases: Siding, Fencing, Shakes, Log Homes, Trim
application_method: Roller (back-brushed for uniform finish)
coverage: 100-350 sq. ft. per gallon, depending on porosity and texture
thinner_cleanup: Water
surface_prep: Remove all existing paint and any deteriorated substrate before applying; new wood typically requires less product than older, weathered wood; can be applied at air/surface/material temperatures as low as 35°F
description: A polyurethane-fortified, self-priming semi-transparent stain for vertical exterior wood surfaces such as siding, fences, shakes, log homes, and trim, formulated to resist peeling and mildew while showing wood grain texture.

name: Wood Classics Interior Waterborne Polyurethane Varnish
use_cases: Interior Wood Trim, Cabinetry, Doors, Windows, Residential Floors
description: An ultra-clear waterborne varnish intended for interior architectural wood trim, cabinetry, doors, windows, and residential floors, formulated to create a tough, durable film.

name: Cetol HLS Plus
type: Exterior Wood Stain – Base Coat (Translucent, Satin, Low Build)
use_cases: Cladding, Fascias, Soffits, Fencing, Garden Furniture, Handrails, Exterior Decking
application_method: Brush (long-haired, soft bristle); apply full flowing coat, redistribute excess with dry brush after 5-20 minutes
coats_recommended: 1 coat as base coat under 2 coats Cetol Filter 7 Plus (new/bare softwood); 2 coats for maintenance on previously stained wood
coverage: Approx. 11-14 m²/L at 10 micron dry film thickness (varies with wood species, surface condition, and application method)
thinner_cleanup: Ready for use, do not thin; clean brushes and equipment with white spirit
surface_prep: Timber must be clean, dry, and free from dust, dirt, grease, and existing paint/varnish coatings
description: A translucent, solvent-borne, alkyd-emulsion base stain used as the priming/base coat in the Cetol Filter 7 Plus exterior wood coating system, giving initial UV and moisture protection to exterior softwood and hardwood.

name: Cetol Filter 7 Plus
type: Exterior Wood Stain – Topcoat (Translucent, Satin, Medium Build)
use_cases: Exterior Joinery, Windows, Doors
application_method: Brush, roller, or spray
coats_recommended: 2 coats, applied over 1 coat of Cetol HLS Plus base coat
coverage: Approx. 10-16 m²/L on smooth surfaces; approx. 6-8 m²/L on rough-sawn surfaces (approx. 18 micron dry film thickness)
voc_content: Max. 400 g/L VOC (EU limit value for product category A/e: 400 g/L, 2010)
thinner_cleanup: Ready for use, do not thin; clean brushes and equipment with white spirit immediately after use
surface_prep: Sand back flaking/weathered coating on older timber; clean with Sikkens Cetol BL Deck & Wood Cleaner if needed, rinse and allow to dry; timber moisture content should be below 15%
description: A highly durable, medium-build, translucent satin wood stain used as the finishing topcoat over Cetol HLS Plus on exterior softwood and hardwood joinery such as windows and doors; not intended for decking.

name: Cetol Novatech
type: Exterior Wood Stain – Base Coat (Translucent, High-Build, Semi-Gloss)
use_cases: Cladding, Fencing, Smooth-Planed Softwood and Hardwood
sheen: Semi-gloss (approx. 50-60 GU/60° initial, reducing to approx. 30-40 GU/60° after 1 month)
application_method: Brush
coats_recommended: 2 coats for new/bare timber; 1 coat for maintenance
coverage: Approx. 27-30 m²/L at approx. 20 micron dry film thickness per coat (minimum system dry film thickness 30 microns)
thinner_cleanup: Ready for use, do not thin; clean brushes and equipment with white spirit/mineral turpentine immediately after use
surface_prep: Surfaces must be clean, dry, and free of dust, dirt, and other contaminants; timber moisture content should not exceed 16%; denib previously stained timber with a fine abrasive pad or P240-grade (or finer) paper
description: A high-solids, medium-to-high-build, solvent-borne wood stain based on a new generation of alkyd binders, used as a one-coat base stain beneath Cetol Novatop, or as a stand-alone translucent finish, on semi-stable exterior substrates such as cladding and fencing.

name: Cetol Novatop
use_cases: Exterior Joinery, Windows, Doors
application_method: Brush (long-haired, soft bristle)
coats_recommended: 1 coat, applied over Cetol Novatech base coat (2-coat Novatech/Novatop system)
coverage: Approx. 17-20 m²/L at approx. 35 micron dry film thickness
thinner_cleanup: Ready for use, do not thin; clean brushes with white spirit
surface_prep: Timber must be clean, dry, and free of dust, dirt, wax, and grease; moisture content should not exceed 16%
description: A high-solids, low-solvent, one-coat translucent semi-gloss topcoat applied over Cetol Novatech to form a flexible, weather-resistant two-coat system for exterior softwood and hardwood window and door joinery; not suitable for interior use, decking, or oily timbers such as iroko or teak.

name: Hydrolux Topcoat SM
use_cases: Timber Windows, Timber Doors, Exterior Joinery
application_method: Spray application (air-assisted airless recommended; conventional gravity-fed pot gun spray with 2-2.5mm nozzle also possible), onto primed timber
voc_content: EU limit value (cat. A/d): 130 g/l VOC
thinner_cleanup: Water (thin no more than 10% for spray viscosity)
surface_prep: Timber moisture content 12-16%; substrate must be clean, dry, and free from dust, dirt, grease, silicone and wax; apply over primed timber
description: A water-based industrial topcoat built on Tri-Cryl technology, spray-applied over primed exterior timber windows and doors for a durable, weather-resistant finish.

name: Ankolux Aqua Impregnating Woodstain
use_cases: Exterior Cladding, Fencing, Gates, Outdoor Furniture, Garden Sheds
application_method: Brush, roller, or sprayer, applied in thin, even coats
surface_prep: Timber moisture content 12-16%; substrate must be clean, dry, and free from dust, dirt, grease, silicone and wax
description: A water-borne, low-film-forming, translucent impregnating wood stain for exterior timber that penetrates the wood fibers, used as a stand-alone weather-resisting finish or as a base coat before Ankolux Aqua Woodcoat TP.

name: Ankolux Aqua Woodcoat TP
use_cases: Facade Cladding, Exterior Joinery, Dimensionally Unstable Timber
application_method: Spray (air-assisted airless or airless); also suitable for brush and roller
description: A water-borne, translucent, film-forming wood coating made from PU and modified alkyd emulsion, formulated to resist peeling and flaking on exterior cladding and dimensionally unstable timber, typically applied over Ankolux Aqua Impregnating Woodstain.

name: Ankocryl Interior PU Topcoat
use_cases: Kitchen Cabinets, Bedroom Furniture, Staircases, Skirting Boards, Interior Joinery
application_method: Spray application (conventional gravity-fed pot gun, HVLP, or air-assisted airless pump)
description: A single-component, waterborne interior topcoat blending self-crosslinking acrylic and polyurethane dispersions, designed to rival two-component systems in scratch, abrasion, and household-chemical resistance for interior furniture and joinery.

name: Water-Borne Impregnating 420
use_cases: Exterior Wood, Conifers, Hardwoods Low in Tannin
application_method: Brush or spray
coats_recommended: 1 (per ICRO CATAS-certified standard exterior painting cycle)
dry_time_recoat: 4 hours (per ICRO CATAS-certified standard exterior painting cycle, before topcoat application)
description: A water-based impregnating agent formulated for exterior wood, intended for use on conifers and hardwoods with low tannin content as the base layer of ICRO's CATAS-certified exterior wood coating system.

name: Olio Giulia
use_cases: Parquet Floors, Furniture
description: A blend of oils and waxes intended to enhance and protect wood with a light toning effect, aimed at parquet floors and furniture, especially absorbent or highly porous wood surfaces.

name: Water-Based Coatings 8007 Soft Matt
application_method: Spray
description: A water-based soft-matt topcoat for spray application, formulated for exceptional hardness, scratch resistance, and an anti-glare, soft-touch surface feel.

name: Water-Borne Varnish TIX 199
application_method: Spray
description: A single-component (1K) thixotropic water-based varnish for spray application, offering good transparency, stretchability, and high scratch resistance.

name: Renner YL-M602/C02 Barrier Coat
type: Waterborne 2K Isolating Barrier Coat / Sealer Primer
use_cases: Furniture Components, Doors, Shutters, Cabinetry, MDF, All Wood Types
application_method: Spray (Airmix or Airless)
thinner_cleanup: Water (cleanup). Two-component system - one distributor listing names Renner YC-M402 as the hardener, but the exact mix ratio could not be independently confirmed
description: A two-component (2K) water-based isolating/barrier primer for interior use, intended for furniture components, doors and shutters on all wood types and MDF, with an anti-yellowing acrylic base and reduced fibre raising.

name: Renner YL-M543/C02 White Primer
use_cases: Furniture, MDF, Solid Wood, Cabinetry
application_method: Spray (low-pressure or airless, with or without air-assist)
thinner_cleanup: Water (cleanup). Ready-to-use 1K formulation - no hardener/catalyst required
description: A ready-to-use, single-component (1K) white water-based primer for interior use, designed to prime MDF or solid wood ahead of painting, and to serve as the basecoat beneath pigmented water-based topcoats.

name: Renner YL-M641/C02 White Primer
use_cases: Furniture, Cabinetry, Doors, Millwork, MDF, Masonite, Kitchens, Bathrooms
application_method: Spray
coats_recommended: 2 coats recommended (up to 3 for full build)
dry_time_cure: Sandable after approx. 8 hours (20C / 65% RH; longer at lower temp/higher humidity)
thinner_cleanup: Water (cleanup). Usable straight from the can on new wood, or catalysed roughly 5-10% with Renner YC-M404 hardener; catalysing required when applying over previously coated substrates
description: A one/two-component (1K/2K) water-based basecoat primer for interior wood and MDF furniture, cabinetry, doors and millwork. Can be tinted with Renner colorant pastes to match the topcoat's base tone; catalysing with hardener increases pot life, tannin-blocking, adhesion and durability.

name: Renner YL-M641/NTR Primer
type: Waterborne 1K/2K Pigmentable Basecoat Primer, Neutral/Clear Base
use_cases: Furniture, Cabinetry, Doors, Millwork, MDF
application_method: Spray
dry_time_cure: Under a forced-air cure schedule from Renner's own TDS: flash-off 10 min at 30C, then 45 min at 45C, cool 5 min at 25C, sandable in as little as approx. 2 hours under this schedule (ambient/room-temp cure takes longer and was not separately quantified)
thinner_cleanup: Water (cleanup). Catalysed with Renner YC-M401 hardener at 4%
description: The neutral/clear-base (NTR) variant of Renner's YL-M641 one/two-component water-based basecoat primer. Can be tinted with Renner's EY-M460 series waterborne pigment pastes (up to about 4%) to build a custom tone beneath the topcoat. NTR denotes the neutral/uncoloured base of the same M641 formulation sold pre-pigmented as /C02 (white) and other colour codes.

name: Renner YL-M643/C02 White Primer
use_cases: Furniture, Cabinetry, Doors, Millwork, MDF, All Wood Types, Refinishing
application_method: Spray (Hand Spray / Air Mix)
coats_recommended: Typically 2 coats; usable as 1 coat ready-to-use (1K) or catalysed (2K)
coverage: Apply at 4-5 wet mils per coat
dry_time_touch: Dust-free approx. 30 minutes; tack-free approx. 60 minutes (at 77F/25C)
thinner_cleanup: Water (cleanup). Optional 2K catalysation: approx. 8% Renner YC.1400 hardener, or approx. 10% YC-M404 hardener; pot life approx. 4 hours at 77F/25C once catalysed. On tannin-rich or resinous woods (oak, acacia, ash) or refinish jobs, 5-10% hardener (YC-M401/YC-M402) is recommended to prevent tannin bleed-through
surface_prep: Substrate must be clean and free of grease, wax and resin, and dry; sand bare wood or existing coating with 220-240 grit paper
description: A mono/bi-component (1K/2K) white water-based basecoat primer for wood and MDF, offering high insulating and covering power for a smooth surface ahead of topcoating. Ready to use as a 1K product or catalysed as 2K for improved performance; can be overcoated with waterborne interior topcoats or solvent-based PU topcoats.

name: Renner YL-M602 Barrier Coat
use_cases: Furniture Components, Doors, Shutters, Interior Wood & MDF Substrates
application_method: Spray (Airmix or Airless)
thinner_cleanup: Water (2K system; hardener required, exact mix ratio not confirmed)
surface_prep: Suitable for all wood types and MDF
description: A two-component, water-based urethane barrier coat used as an isolating primer on interior wood furniture components, doors and shutters, offering transparency/brightness comparable to solvent-based primers with an anti-yellowing acrylic base and reduced fibre raising on wood and MDF.

name: Renner YL-M574 Barrier Coat
type: Waterborne 2K Insulating Basecoat for Parquet/Wood Flooring
use_cases: Parquet Flooring, Interior Wood Floors (Oily Wood Species e.g. Iroko, Merbau)
thinner_cleanup: Water
description: A two-component, water-based insulating/barrier basecoat applied as the first coat on parquet and interior wood flooring to reduce solubilisation of resins and oils found in oily wood species such as iroko and merbau.

name: Renner YL-M653 Sealer
use_cases: Interior Wood Furniture, Cabinets, Doors, Window Frames, Turned Parts
application_method: Spray (Airless or Air-Assisted Airless; HVLP)
thinner_cleanup: Water
surface_prep: Automatic machine sanding compatible
description: A one-component (1K), water-based high-build sanding sealer providing high transparency and quick drying for a smooth foundation coat prior to topcoating on interior wood furniture and joinery; compatible with waterborne and solvent-based topcoats including polyurethane and nitrocellulose.

name: Renner YL-M663 Sealer
use_cases: Interior Wood Surfaces
thinner_cleanup: Water
description: A one-component, water-based transparent sealer/primer varnish for interior wood applications.

name: Renner YL-V678 Sealer
use_cases: Interior Wood Surfaces, Professional/Trade Use
thinner_cleanup: Water
description: A high-performance, water-based self-sealer for professional interior wood finishing.

name: Renner YO-M760/SBN Top Coat
type: Waterborne Pigmented Interior Topcoat, White-Pigmentable Base
use_cases: Furniture, Kitchens, Wardrobes, Cabinetry, Interior Joinery
sheen: Available in multiple sheen levels via a numeric code prefix; not specified by this base code
application_method: Professional spray (HVLP gravity-fed / conventional air spray gun, fluid tip approx. 1.8-2.2mm; airless with approx. 310 tip)
thinner_cleanup: Tap water (product is ready-to-use; thin only if needed)
surface_prep: Sand substrate with 320-400 grit paper. Apply only over water-based, polyester (PE), or UV-cured basecoats - not suitable over nitrocellulose or PU basecoats.
description: A professional water-based pigmented topcoat for interior wood finishing (furniture, kitchens, wardrobes, cabinetry, joinery), formulated with non-yellowing polyurethane/acrylic resins for colour stability. /SBN denotes the white-pigmentable base (pigmentable up to approx. 4%), part of Renner's SBN (white)/NTR (neutral) base convention.

name: Renner YO-M760/NTR Top Coat
type: Waterborne Pigmented Interior Topcoat, Neutral-Pigmentable Base (up to 18%)
use_cases: Furniture, Kitchens, Wardrobes, Cabinetry, Interior Joinery
sheen: Available in multiple sheen levels via a numeric code prefix; not specified by this base code
application_method: Professional spray (HVLP gravity-fed / conventional air spray gun, fluid tip approx. 1.8-2.2mm; airless with approx. 310 tip)
thinner_cleanup: Tap water or Renner AYM453 additive to reach optimal viscosity (approx. 45 sec, DIN 6 cup)
surface_prep: Sand substrate with 320-400 grit paper. Apply only over water-based, polyester (PE), or UV-cured basecoats - not suitable over nitrocellulose or PU basecoats.
description: A professional water-based pigmented topcoat for interior wood finishing (furniture, kitchens, wardrobes, cabinetry, joinery), formulated with non-yellowing polyurethane/acrylic resins for colour stability. /NTR is the neutral/clear-pigmentable base, tintable up to a maximum of 18%, part of Renner's SBN (white)/NTR (neutral) base convention.

name: Renner YO-C762/SBN Top Coat
type: Waterborne 1K Acrylic/Polyurethane Pigmented Topcoat, White-Pigmentable Base
use_cases: Furniture, Flat Parts, Turned Parts, Picture Frames, Skirting Boards
sheen: Available in multiple sheen levels via a numeric code prefix; not specified by this base code
application_method: Conventional spray application; can be thinned approx. 5-10% with tap water to aid flow with smaller tip sizes
thinner_cleanup: Tap water for thinning/cleanup. Optional 2K use: crosslinker YC-M407 can be added (reported at approx. 0.5-2% across sources) for improved chemical/stack resistance
surface_prep: Sand substrate with 320-400 grit paper. Apply only over water-based, polyester (PE), or UV-cured basecoats - not suitable over nitrocellulose or PU basecoats.
description: A pigmented 1K water-based acrylic/polyurethane interior topcoat for furniture, flat/turned parts, picture frames and skirting boards, offering good hardness and chemical resistance; can optionally be crosslinked with YC-M407 for enhanced performance. /SBN is the white-pigmentable base (up to approx. 4%).

name: Renner YO-C762/NTR Top Coat
type: Waterborne 1K Acrylic/Polyurethane Pigmented Topcoat, Neutral-Pigmentable Base (up to 18%)
use_cases: Furniture, Flat Parts, Turned Parts, Picture Frames, Skirting Boards
sheen: Available in multiple sheen levels via a numeric code prefix; not specified by this base code
application_method: Conventional spray application; can be thinned approx. 5-10% with tap water to aid flow with smaller tip sizes
thinner_cleanup: Tap water for thinning/cleanup. Optional 2K use: crosslinker YC-M407 can be added (reported at approx. 0.5-2% across sources) for improved chemical/stack resistance
surface_prep: Sand substrate with 320-400 grit paper. Apply only over water-based, polyester (PE), or UV-cured basecoats - not suitable over nitrocellulose or PU basecoats.
description: A pigmented 1K water-based acrylic/polyurethane interior topcoat, particularly recommended for flat parts subject to prolonged wear or chemical contact; also used for furniture, turned parts, picture frames and skirting boards. /NTR is the neutral-pigmentable base (up to 18%).

name: Renner YO-M785/SBN Top Coat
type: Waterborne 2K Matt/Semi-Matt Pigmented Topcoat (Converter), White-Pigmentable Base
use_cases: Flat Parts, Furniture (Interior 2K Lacquer System)
application_method: Spray (conventional air gun, airless, or airmix suitable for water-based products)
thinner_cleanup: 2K product - requires hardener before use: YC-M403, YC-M404, YC-M402, or YC-M401 at 4-10%; thin with a small amount of tap water if needed. Converter-to-paste mix ratio approx. 90:10.
surface_prep: Sand substrate with 320-400 grit paper. Compatible with water-based, PE, UV, and PU basecoats - not recommended over nitro or acid-catalysed basecoats.
description: A 2-component (2K) matt/semi-matt water-based converter-topcoat for flat furniture parts, mixed with a Renner YC-M40x hardener (4-10%) before spray application. /SBN is the "matt white converter" base.

name: Renner YO-M785/NTR Top Coat
type: Waterborne 2K Matt/Semi-Matt Pigmented Topcoat (Converter), Neutral-Pigmentable Base (up to 18%)
use_cases: Flat Parts, Furniture (Interior 2K Lacquer System)
application_method: Spray (conventional air gun, airless, or airmix suitable for water-based products)
thinner_cleanup: 2K product - requires hardener before use: YC-M403, YC-M404, YC-M402, or YC-M401 at 4-10%; optimal viscosity approx. 20-30 sec (DIN 8 cup). Converter-to-paste mix ratio approx. 90:10.
surface_prep: Sand substrate with 320-400 grit paper. Compatible with water-based, PE, UV, and PU basecoats - not recommended over nitro or acid-catalysed basecoats.
description: A 2-component (2K) matt/semi-matt water-based converter-topcoat for flat furniture parts, mixed with a Renner YC-M40x hardener (4-10%) before spray application. /NTR is the "matt neutral converter" base, pigmentable up to a maximum of 18%.

name: Renner YO-M863 Self Sealer/Topcoat
use_cases: Open-Pore Wood Substrates, Furniture, Interior Wood Surfaces
thinner_cleanup: Water; optionally catalysed with 1% YC-M407 hardener for extra chemical/mechanical resistance
surface_prep: Particularly suited to open-pore substrates
description: A ready-to-use, one-component (1K) clear water-based self-sealer for interior wood, particularly suited to open-pore substrates, with good vertical hold and chemical resistance; usable as a self-sealing finish on its own or as a topcoat over clear water-based sealers.

name: Renner YO-M785 Self Sealer/Topcoat
use_cases: Interior Wood Furniture, Cabinetry
application_method: Spray (Conventional Air Gun, Airless, or Airmix)
thinner_cleanup: Water; 2K - catalysed with YC-M403, YC-M404, YC-M402, or YC-M401 hardener at 4-10%
surface_prep: Sand with 320-400 grit; apply over water-based, PE, UV, or PU basecoats (not recommended over nitrocellulose or acid-catalysed basecoats)
description: A two-component (2K), water-based clear interior lacquer/topcoat - the clear variant, without an /SBN or /NTR suffix - available in a 10-30 sheen range, designed as a self-sealing finish or topcoat over water-based, PE, UV, or PU basecoats, catalysed with one of several Renner hardeners at 4-10%.

name: Renner YO-M838 Self Sealer/Topcoat
use_cases: Wood Flooring, Parquet
thinner_cleanup: Water
description: A water-based 1K/2K zero-sheen (invisible-finish) topcoat and self-sealer for wood flooring, formulated with polyurethane resins and UV filters for non-yellowing, wear-resistant, elastic, low-solvent protection of natural wood colour.

name: Renner YO-05M755 Self Sealer/Topcoat
use_cases: Furniture Components, Cabinet Doors, Panels, Gates
application_method: Spray
thinner_cleanup: Water; 2K - catalysed with YC-M402 hardener (distributor pages cite approx. 10%, not confirmed against manufacturer TDS)
description: A two-component, water-based interior finish with a natural wood effect, offering non-yellowing performance, good flow and grain definition, and a long pot-life; usable as both a primer/basecoat and a finish coat on furniture components, cabinet doors and panels.

name: Renner YC-M419 Crosslinker
use_cases: Crosslinker for Mono- or Bi-Component Renner Coatings, Glass Adhesion (Decorative/Architectural Glass, Glass Furniture Panels)
application_method: Not applied standalone - per the Renner YC-M4xx TDS it must first be pre-mixed 1:1 with DTM075, then added slowly to the base product under mechanical mixing
thinner_cleanup: 1-2% per the official Renner YC-M4xx technical data sheet. Very slow drying; deactivates roughly 24 hours after mixing. Shelf life approx. 12 months at 5-35C.
description: Water-based crosslinker developed to improve adhesion and resistance on glass. Added at a low percentage to mono- or bi-component Renner coatings, it must be pre-mixed with DTM075 before slow addition to the base product and deactivates roughly 24 hours after mixing.

name: Renner YC-M407 Crosslinker
use_cases: Crosslinker for Renner Water-Based Basecoats and Topcoats
application_method: Not applied standalone - added to and blended into the base coating under mechanical stirring; add slowly to avoid air bubbles on high-gloss sheens
thinner_cleanup: 0.5-1% per the official Renner YC-M4xx TDS. Medium drying character; overall pot life of the mixed system reported as 24-48 hours depending on the base product used.
description: General-purpose water-based crosslinker blended into Renner basecoats and topcoats at a low percentage to boost durability, chemical resistance and glass adhesion, distinguished within the M4xx family by its medium drying speed and longer pot life.

name: Renner YC-M402 Hardener
use_cases: Catalyst for Two-Pack Renner Water-Based Primers/Sealers (e.g. YL-M641, YL-M643)
application_method: Not applied standalone - blended into the base primer/sealer under mechanical mixing; the catalysed product must be spray-applied with air-fed respiratory protection
thinner_cleanup: Dosage varies by base product - reported figures range roughly 1-2% (MDF grain-raising reduction) up to 4-8% (general primer/sealer catalysing); refer to the specific base product's own TDS for the exact ratio. Pot life of the mixed system is approximately 3 hours.
description: Water-based polyurethane hardener used to catalyse two-pack Renner primers and sealers, improving adhesion for overcoating. The catalysed mixture has roughly a 3-hour pot life and must be spray-applied with proper respiratory protection.

name: Renner YC-M403 Hardener
use_cases: Catalyst for Renner Water-Based Basecoats/Topcoats Including Parquet Finishes; Required for Rennerplast 2K Converter YO-U974
application_method: Not applied standalone - blended into the base product with a mechanical mixer; application/substrate/environment temperature should not fall below 15C
thinner_cleanup: Required at 10% for the Rennerplast 2K converter YO-U974; general-purpose dosage elsewhere reported around 4-10% depending on base product. Pot life of the mixed system is approximately 3 hours.
description: Water-based hardener for Renner basecoats/topcoats, including parquet finishes, most notably specified as the required 10% catalyst for the Rennerplast 2K converter YO-U974. The mixed product has roughly a 3-hour pot life.

name: Renner AY-M444 Retardant
use_cases: Additive for Waterborne Renner Topcoats and Basecoats
application_method: Not applied standalone - added directly to the waterborne base product with mechanical agitation before the base product is applied by its normal method
description: Retardant/flow additive blended in small quantities into waterborne Renner coatings to slow the drying process, extending open time for better levelling and a smoother finish.

name: Renner AY-M433 Antibacterial Additive (Silver Defence)
use_cases: Antimicrobial Additive for Water-Based Renner Transparent Lacquers or Tinted Topcoats
application_method: Not applied standalone - blended into the base topcoat/lacquer; does not alter the base product's normal application process
